name: When should I consider accessible furniture space planning for my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider accessible furniture space planning for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider accessible furniture space planning when renovating, building a new home, or proactively preparing for future needs. It's also essential if you or a family member has a current mobility challenge, uses a wheelchair, or has vision impairment. Implementing these plans early can save significant costs and disruption compared to making modifications later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider it during renovations, new construction, or when current or future mobility needs arise for you or a family member.
